mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_session(user_id, session_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT s.session_id, s.user_id, u.nickname AS user_name,
(SELECT m1.content FROM t_chat_message m1 WHERE m1.session_id = s.session_id AND m1.role = 'user' AND m1.content IS NOT NULL AND m1.content <> '' ORDER BY m1.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS title,
(SELECT m2.content FROM t_chat_message m2 WHERE m2.session_id = s.session_id ORDER BY m2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM t_chat_session s
LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = s.user_id
s.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY s.update_time DESC, s.id DESC
